title: Wedge The Touch Game (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the wedge is the touch club
Clock face system, nine three, ten two, eleven one
Thats the distance control right there

[Verse 1]
Nine to three on the wedge, sixty yards
Ten to two on the wedge, eighty yards plays the cards
Eleven to one on the wedge, full swing one ten
Clock face system, son, thats the wedge yardage zen

[Pre-Chorus]
Ball back of center half a ball, hands ahead two
Weight sixty forty lead side, thats what wedges do
Narrow stance, feet flared open ten degrees
Rotate through, let the loft work the breeze

[Chorus]
Wedge the touch game, soft hands son
Clock face yardage, thats how wedges run
Nine three, ten two, eleven one
Three distances, never overdone

[Verse 2]
Fifty six degree sand wedge, sixty degree lob
Fifty two gap wedge, forty eight pitching for the job
Four wedges in the bag, four yardage maps
Know each one, son, dont fall in the gaps

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, wedge play wins tournaments
Get up and down sixty percent of the time
Thats the pro standard, thats the dime
Practice the touch shots, son, every spare moment

[Chorus]
Wedge the touch game, soft hands son
Clock face yardage, thats how wedges run
Nine three, ten two, eleven one
Three distances, never overdone

[Outro]
Nine three sixty, ten two eighty
Eleven one a hundred ten, the wedge baby
Soft hands, accelerate through
Thats my boy, thats your cue
